definitions.explanation: The number which, multiplied by itself three times, gives the number in question. A standard term in Japanese school mathematics.

examples.japanese: {八|はち}の{立方根|りっぽうこん}は{二|に}だ。
{電卓|でんたく}で{立方根|りっぽうこん}を{計算|けいさん}した。
examples.english: I calculated the cube root on a calculator.

examples.japanese: {体積|たいせき}が{分|わ}かっていれば、{立方根|りっぽうこん}を{取|と}ることで{一辺|いっぺん}の{長|なが}さが{求|もと}められる。
examples.english: If you know the volume, you can find the length of one side by taking the cube root.

notes:
{立方|りっぽう} means cube (as in {立方|りっぽう}メートル, cubic metre) and {根|こん} here means root in the mathematical sense.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立方根|りっぽうこん}を{求|もと}める: to find the cube root
- {立方根|りっぽうこん}を{取|と}る: to take the cube root
- {立方根|りっぽうこん}を{計算|けいさん}する: to calculate the cube root

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {平方根|へいほうこん}: square root — the same idea with two factors instead of three
- {立方体|りっぽうたい}: cube (the solid shape) — the geometric figure, not a number
